subject: PharmaHub — data disposition evidence and 90d log TTL carveout
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@pharmahub.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: PharmaHub Legal <legal@pharmahub.com>, SOC-team <soc-team@pharmahub.com>
Date: 2028-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial evidence request — data disposition + log TTL variance

Hi Markus / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of PharmaHub's SIG/CAIQ review we have a few customer-specific asks around session/debug logs and deletion evidence before we can move to procurement:

- PharmaHub retains session/debug logs for up to 90 days, but our policy requires a subset of audit logs be retained longer for forensics. We need to understand whether Redwood can support a 90-day TTL for tenant-scoped debug traces while still providing attestation and exportability for forensic requests.
- Please provide the exact artifacts you can produce to demonstrate deletion (e.g., deletion runbook excerpt, job logs showing completed destroys, sample "redaction" reports, retention matrix mapping).
- We need SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months), and a SIG questionnaire subset answered around data lifecycle. We're attaching our questionnaire (pharmahub_sig_questions_v2.xlsx).

Can you acknowledge what you can supply and an estimated delivery timeline? If there's anything that requires legal sign-off (data disposition carveouts), flag that up so we can route internally.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Security Engineer
PharmaHub

--
Attachment: pharmahub_sig_questions_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@pharmahub.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial evidence request — data disposition + log TTL variance

Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can support PharmaHub's ask but there are a few implementation and evidence details to align on. High level we can provide:

- SOC 2 Type II (most recent) PDF and SOC control matrix extracted for retention-related controls.
- A "Retention & Deletion" matrix that maps Redwood storage tiers, TTLs, and the events that trigger deletion (included: session/debug traces, KV caches, audit logs). I attached a draft (data_lifecycle_matrix.pdf).
- A redaction/deletion playbook snippet that describes the deletion job, verification steps, and S3/object lifecycle rules — included as delete-playbook.md.
- For forensics: we can produce targeted exports of retained audit logs and provide a tamper-evidence timeline (hashing) for exported bundles.

Notes / constraints:
- The 90-day tenant-scoped debug TTL is possible for hosted customers with a documented carveout, but for Dedicated/Private deployments we may need slightly different artifacting depending on where logs are stored.
- Anything that materially changes our default retention will need an exception signed by our Legal team (we can draft an addendum).

Proposed next steps:
1) I will hand this to Neha (compliance) to assemble the deliverables and confirm whether we can produce a handwritten attestation for the carveout.
2) If PharmaHub is OK, we can schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to walk the artifacts and answer technical questions.

Marissa — please help coordinate contract/legal if an addendum is required.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: data_lifecycle_matrix.pdf (pdf), delete-playbook.md (text)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@pharmahub.com>
Date: 2028-05-12T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Initial evidence request — data disposition + log TTL variance

Neha — looping you in to lead on the PharmaHub evidence bundle. Quick asks:

- Can we confirm whether we can support a documented 90-day tenant debug TTL with accompanying deletion proofs (hashes/export logs) for a hosted customer? Any differences for Dedicated/Private?
- What evidence formats can we provide (PDF, CSV export, signed attestation)?
- If an addendum is required for the carveout, do we have a standard template or should Legal draft one?

Elena — we expect Neha to propose a deliverable list + timeline. Marissa will serve as the account lead for the procurement path.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

On 2028-05-11 11:05, Markus Klein wrote:
> Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can support PharmaHub's ask but there are a few implementation and evidence details to align on. High level we can provide: ...

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@pharmahub.com>, PharmaHub Legal <legal@pharmahub.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-16T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial evidence request — data disposition + log TTL variance

Hi Elena / PharmaHub team — thanks for the patience. I've pulled together what Redwood can deliver for the 90-day tenant debug TTL carveout and corresponding evidence. Summary below and attached is a packaged evidence bundle (pharmahub_evidence_bundle.zip) with redacted extracts where appropriate.

What we can deliver (items + format):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and an exported SOC control mapping highlighting retention/deletion controls (CSV).
- SIG/CAIQ responses: we will return the filled SIG subset in spreadsheet form and point you to CAIQ controls that map to our deletion workflows (we'll populate the pharmahub_sig_questions_v2.xlsx you sent).
- Retention & Deletion Matrix (PDF): maps object types (session/debug traces, audit logs, KV caches, model artifacts) to storage tiers, default TTLs, and triggers for deletion.
- Deletion playbook (MD): excerpt of the operational runbook describing scheduled deletion jobs, verification, and exception handling; includes sample job run output (timestamps + job-run-id).
- Forensics export process: we can perform a scoped export with cryptographic checksums (SHA256) and provide a manifest.
- Attestation: we can provide a signed attestation letter (PDF) for the 90-day carveout stating Redwood will implement the documented deletion behaviour for the PharmaHub tenant in Hosted mode. For Dedicated/Private we will document scope differences in the attestation.

Timeline & next steps:
- I can deliver the complete evidence bundle and populated SIG subset within 5 business days (by 2028-05-23).
- If PharmaHub requires a contractual carveout, our Legal team will prepare an addendum; please provide the preferred POC for signature (we've included an optional DocuSign link below).

Deliverables (examples included in the bundle):
- pharmahub_evidence_bundle.zip (contains SOC2 excerpt, retention_matrix.csv, deletion_job_sample.log, attestation_draft.pdf)

Please confirm that the above format meets your needs or call out any additional specifics (e.g., retention-proof hashes stored in a particular KMS, longer audit log windows for a scoped subset). Happy to schedule the follow-up to walk through the artifacts.

Neha Kapoor
Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

--
Attachments: pharmahub_evidence_bundle.zip (zip)
Related links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=example-evidence-folder, https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123
